workflow.title: Plan a Walmart shipment with pallet staging
workflow.description: Compare complete current and EDI-recovery shipment arrangements with pallet staging, delivery, resource, permission and cash constraints. Calculate optional learning value only when its assumptions are supplied.
workflow.question: Can we complete this Walmart order, and which complete recovery route remains workable if a requirement is blocked?

authoring.guidance: Populate the installed pattern contract. Supply business meanings as module data and reviewed observations as case data.

definition.title: Establish the required answer
definition.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

caseDerivation: Basis and evidence relation IDs, columns, scalar types, keys and references come from the frozen module.relations.
Case parameters use frozen module.parameters types, defaults, bounds and enumerations.
Case queryIds select distinct frozen module.queries; evaluation settings can only lower installed finite limits.
schema.description: This describes the installed validators and supported presence-restriction paths; it is not a complete JSON Schema.

structuralSlots.description: Declare typed basis, evidence, assignment and derived relation schemas.
Declare typed case parameters, defaults and permitted bounds.
Declare bounded finite subset dimensions over submitted input relation columns.
Declare finite relational rules with stratified negation and count.
Declare consistency checks on generated interpretations.
Declare checks on submitted basis and evidence facts before enumeration.
Declare the exact required Boolean, value or set answer.
Bind domain vocabulary and report organization to declared entities and calculated values.
Declare report tables over declared relations.
State the premises and conclusion boundary reviewed by people.

caseInputs.description: Identify this case.
State the scope of the supplied information.
Supply values within the published parameter declarations.
Supply typed facts for relations marked basis.
Supply typed facts for relations marked evidence.
Select the published questions to assess.
Optionally lower finite evaluation limits.
Optionally name this case.

responsibilities: Supplied basis, evidence, assumptions and assessment checks
Case changes when comparison context is supplied

app.name: Review Walmart first-order readiness evidence
app.description: Illustrative Walmart US first-party order profile. The author fixes qualifying source meanings; case workers supply identified observations and exact scope. This is not an official Walmart compliance determination.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: walmart-first-order-staged-evidence
  version: "1.2.0"
  title: Review Walmart first-order readiness evidence
  description: "Illustrative Walmart US first-party order profile. The author fixes qualifying source meanings; case workers supply identified observations and exact scope. This is not an official Walmart compliance determination."
  question: "What do the reviewed records establish about the four readiness prerequisites?"
  boundary: "One scoped accepted order revision, four authored readiness families and sixteen explicitly admitted joint possibilities. Unknown is neither false nor a probability. Planned recovery is not observed readiness. Validity is checked at the assessment time here and again at the required route activity time in planning."
  assumptions: ["This fictional profile treats correctly scoped, current, accepted observations from each author-qualified kind as accurate for the claim they assert.", The fixed sixteen-row joint support table permits every logical readiness combination before evidence. It supplies no probability weights or claim of statistical independence., "A strictly later eligible record may explicitly supersede an earlier same-claim, same-scope record. Recency alone never settles a disagreement.", "Named people and acceptance labels are supplied judgments, not authenticated identities or issued operating permissions."]
  parameters:
    - id: asOfMinute
      type: integer
      min: 0
      label: "Assessment time, in minutes from the declared origin"
  relations:
    - id: expectedScope
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [field]
    - id: source
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: kind
          type: string
        - id: authority
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: record
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: observed
          type: integer
        - id: from
          type: integer
        - id: through
          type: integer
        - id: review
          type: string
        - id: reviewer
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: recordScope
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [record, field]
    - id: replacement
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: new
          type: string
        - id: old
          type: string
      key: [new, old]
    - id: scopeMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: qualifyingSource
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: recordIssue
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: eligibleRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: supersededRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: admissibleRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: dispositionOption
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: rank
          type: integer
    - id: overriddenDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
    - id: dispositionMeaning
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: recordDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: positiveClaim
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
    - id: negativeClaim
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
    - id: claimFinding
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: status
          type: string
    - id: state
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: edi
          type: boolean
        - id: itemorder
          type: boolean
        - id: transport
          type: boolean
        - id: freight
          type: boolean
      key: [id]
    - id: selectedState
      source: assignment
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: stateDetails
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: edi
          type: boolean
        - id: itemorder
          type: boolean
        - id: transport
          type: boolean
        - id: freight
          type: boolean
    - id: stateClaim
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: state
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: recordMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: expected
          type: boolean
        - id: recorded
          type: boolean
  rules:
    - id: SCOPE.MISSING.OR.DIFFERENT
      head:
        relation: scopeMismatch
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: expectedScope
          args: ["?field", "?expected"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: recordScope
            args: ["?record", "?field", "?expected"]
    - id: SCOPE.EXTRA.OR.DIFFERENT
      head:
        relation: scopeMismatch
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: recordScope
          args: ["?record", "?field", "?actual"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: expectedScope
            args: ["?field", "?actual"]
    - id: RECORD.EXACT.SCOPE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", wrong-scope, The record does not match the exact current shipment scope.]
      body:
        - relation: scopeMismatch
          args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.ACCEPTED
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?review", accepted]
    - id: RECORD.IDENTIFIED.REVIEWER
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: eq
          args: ["?reviewer", ""]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.edi.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", edi, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional transaction test record, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.edi.1
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", edi, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional later completed transaction test record, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.item-order.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", item-order, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional accepted order and item reconciliation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.transport.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", transport, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional scoped transportation registration confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.transport.1
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", transport, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional contradictory transportation confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.freight.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", freight, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional accepted freight-term and service confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: RECORD.QUALIFYING.SOURCE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unqualified-source, The supplied source kind does not establish this claim under this profile.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: qualifyingSource
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.ACTUALLY.OBSERVED
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", not-observed, The claimed observation is later than the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: gt
          args:
            - "?observed"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: RECORD.VALID.FROM
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, The record is not valid at the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: gt
          args:
            - "?from"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: RECORD.VALID.THROUGH
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", expired, The record has expired at the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: lt
          args:
            - "?through"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: REPLACEMENT.TARGET.EXISTS
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: record
            args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.SAME.CLAIM
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: record
          args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?claim", "?oldClaim"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.STRICTLY.LATER
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: record
          args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
        - op: lte
          args: ["?observed", "?oldAt"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.SAME.SCOPE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: scopeMismatch
          args: ["?old"]
    - id: RECORD.ELIGIBLE.BEFORE.REPLACEMENT
      head:
        relation: eligibleRecord
        args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: recordIssue
            args: ["?record", "?anyCode", "?anyReason"]
    - id: RECORD.EXPLICITLY.SUPERSEDED
      head:
        relation: supersededRecord
        args: ["?old"]
      body:
        - relation: eligibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
    - id: RECORD.CURRENT.ADMISSIBLE
      head:
        relation: admissibleRecord
        args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
      body:
        - relation: eligibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: supersededRecord
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.wrong-scope
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", wrong-scope, 0]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", wrong-scope, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.unreviewed
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, 1]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", unreviewed, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.unqualified-source
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", unqualified-source, 2]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", unqualified-source, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.not-observed
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", not-observed, 3]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", not-observed, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.not-yet-valid
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, 4]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.expired
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", expired, 5]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", expired, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.invalid-supersession
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, 6]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.SUPERSEDED
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", superseded, 20]
      body:
        - relation: supersededRecord
          args: ["?record"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ADMISSIBLE
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", admissible, 30]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.PRIORITY
      head:
        relation: overriddenDisposition
        args: ["?record", "?code"]
      body:
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?code", "?rank"]
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?preferred", "?lower"]
        - op: lt
          args: ["?lower", "?rank"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.wrong-scope
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [wrong-scope, The record does not match the exact current shipment scope.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.unreviewed
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.unqualified-source
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [unqualified-source, The supplied source kind does not establish this claim under this profile.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.not-observed
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [not-observed, The claimed observation is later than the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.not-yet-valid
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [not-yet-valid, The record is not valid at the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.expired
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [expired, The record has expired at the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.invalid-supersession
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.superseded
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [superseded, A later current accepted record explicitly replaces this earlier same-claim record.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.admissible
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [admissible, "The accepted, current, correctly scoped source qualifies under the authored evidence rule."]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.FINAL
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", "?code", "?reason"]
      body:
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?code", "?rank"]
        - relation: dispositionMeaning
          args: ["?code", "?reason"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: overriddenDisposition
            args: ["?record", "?code"]
    - id: CLAIM.POSITIVE
      head:
        relation: positiveClaim
        args: ["?claim"]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", true]
    - id: CLAIM.NEGATIVE
      head:
        relation: negativeClaim
        args: ["?claim"]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", false]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, established]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, contradicted]
      body:
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.UNRESOLVED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, unresolved]
      body:
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, conflicting]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [edi]
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, established]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [item-order]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, contradicted]
      body:
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [item-order]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.UNRESOLVED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, unresolved]
      body:
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim

        - op: notExists

    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.item-order

    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.transport

definitionContract.title: Establish the required answer
definitionContract.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

module.title: Review Walmart first-order readiness evidence
module.description: Illustrative Walmart US first-party order profile. The author fixes qualifying source meanings; case workers supply identified observations and exact scope. This is not an official Walmart compliance determination.
module.question: What do the reviewed records establish about the four readiness prerequisites?
module.boundary: One scoped accepted order revision, four authored readiness families and sixteen explicitly admitted joint possibilities. Unknown is neither false nor a probability. Planned recovery is not observed readiness. Validity is checked at the assessment time here and again at the required route activity time in planning.
assumptions: This fictional profile treats correctly scoped, current, accepted observations from each author-qualified kind as accurate for the claim they assert.
The fixed sixteen-row joint support table permits every logical readiness combination before evidence. It supplies no probability weights or claim of statistical independence.
A strictly later eligible record may explicitly supersede an earlier same-claim, same-scope record. Recency alone never settles a disagreement.
Named people and acceptance labels are supplied judgments, not authenticated identities or issued operating permissions.

authoring.guidance: Populate the installed pattern contract. Supply business meanings as module data and reviewed observations as case data.

definition.title: Establish the required answer
definition.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

caseDerivation: Basis and evidence relation IDs, columns, scalar types, keys and references come from the frozen module.relations.
Case parameters use frozen module.parameters types, defaults, bounds and enumerations.
Case queryIds select distinct frozen module.queries; evaluation settings can only lower installed finite limits.
schema.description: This describes the installed validators and supported presence-restriction paths; it is not a complete JSON Schema.

structuralSlots.description: Declare typed basis, evidence, assignment and derived relation schemas.
Declare typed case parameters, defaults and permitted bounds.
Declare bounded finite subset dimensions over submitted input relation columns.
Declare finite relational rules with stratified negation and count.
Declare consistency checks on generated interpretations.
Declare checks on submitted basis and evidence facts before enumeration.
Declare the exact required Boolean, value or set answer.
Bind domain vocabulary and report organization to declared entities and calculated values.
Declare report tables over declared relations.
State the premises and conclusion boundary reviewed by people.

caseInputs.description: Identify this case.
State the scope of the supplied information.
Supply values within the published parameter declarations.
Supply typed facts for relations marked basis.
Supply typed facts for relations marked evidence.
Select the published questions to assess.
Optionally lower finite evaluation limits.
Optionally name this case.

responsibilities: Supplied basis, evidence, assumptions and assessment checks
Case changes when comparison context is supplied

app.name: Review first-order source records
app.description: Illustrative Walmart US first-party order profile. The author fixes qualifying source meanings; case workers supply identified observations and exact scope. This is not an official Walmart compliance determination.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: walmart-first-order-staged-dispositions
  version: "1.2.0"
  title: Review first-order source records
  description: "Illustrative Walmart US first-party order profile. The author fixes qualifying source meanings; case workers supply identified observations and exact scope. This is not an official Walmart compliance determination."
  question: "Which records can settle readiness for this order?"
  boundary: "One scoped accepted order revision, four authored readiness families and sixteen explicitly admitted joint possibilities. Unknown is neither false nor a probability. Planned recovery is not observed readiness. Validity is checked at the assessment time here and again at the required route activity time in planning."
  assumptions: ["This fictional profile treats correctly scoped, current, accepted observations from each author-qualified kind as accurate for the claim they assert.", The fixed sixteen-row joint support table permits every logical readiness combination before evidence. It supplies no probability weights or claim of statistical independence., "A strictly later eligible record may explicitly supersede an earlier same-claim, same-scope record. Recency alone never settles a disagreement.", "Named people and acceptance labels are supplied judgments, not authenticated identities or issued operating permissions."]
  parameters:
    - id: asOfMinute
      type: integer
      min: 0
      label: "Assessment time, in minutes from the declared origin"
  relations:
    - id: expectedScope
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [field]
    - id: source
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: kind
          type: string
        - id: authority
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: record
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
        - id: source
          type: string
        - id: observed
          type: integer
        - id: from
          type: integer
        - id: through
          type: integer
        - id: review
          type: string
        - id: reviewer
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: recordScope
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: field
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: string
      key: [record, field]
    - id: replacement
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: new
          type: string
        - id: old
          type: string
      key: [new, old]
    - id: scopeMismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: qualifyingSource
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: recordIssue
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: eligibleRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: supersededRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
    - id: admissibleRecord
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: value
          type: boolean
    - id: dispositionOption
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: rank
          type: integer
    - id: overriddenDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
    - id: dispositionMeaning
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: recordDisposition
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: record
          type: string
        - id: code
          type: string
        - id: reason
          type: string
    - id: positiveClaim
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
    - id: negativeClaim
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
    - id: claimFinding
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: claim
          type: string
        - id: status
          type: string
  rules:
    - id: SCOPE.MISSING.OR.DIFFERENT
      head:
        relation: scopeMismatch
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: expectedScope
          args: ["?field", "?expected"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: recordScope
            args: ["?record", "?field", "?expected"]
    - id: SCOPE.EXTRA.OR.DIFFERENT
      head:
        relation: scopeMismatch
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: recordScope
          args: ["?record", "?field", "?actual"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: expectedScope
            args: ["?field", "?actual"]
    - id: RECORD.EXACT.SCOPE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", wrong-scope, The record does not match the exact current shipment scope.]
      body:
        - relation: scopeMismatch
          args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.ACCEPTED
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?review", accepted]
    - id: RECORD.IDENTIFIED.REVIEWER
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: eq
          args: ["?reviewer", ""]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.edi.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", edi, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional transaction test record, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.edi.1
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", edi, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional later completed transaction test record, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.item-order.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", item-order, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional accepted order and item reconciliation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.transport.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", transport, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional scoped transportation registration confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.transport.1
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", transport, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional contradictory transportation confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: SOURCE.KIND.freight.0
      head:
        relation: qualifyingSource
        args: ["?record"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", freight, "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: source
          args: ["?source", fictional accepted freight-term and service confirmation, "?authority"]
    - id: RECORD.QUALIFYING.SOURCE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", unqualified-source, The supplied source kind does not establish this claim under this profile.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: qualifyingSource
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: RECORD.ACTUALLY.OBSERVED
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", not-observed, The claimed observation is later than the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: gt
          args:
            - "?observed"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: RECORD.VALID.FROM
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, The record is not valid at the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: gt
          args:
            - "?from"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: RECORD.VALID.THROUGH
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", expired, The record has expired at the explicit assessment time.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: lt
          args:
            - "?through"
            - parameter: asOfMinute
    - id: REPLACEMENT.TARGET.EXISTS
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: record
            args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.SAME.CLAIM
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: record
          args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?claim", "?oldClaim"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.STRICTLY.LATER
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: record
          args: ["?old", "?oldClaim", "?oldValue", "?oldSource", "?oldAt", "?oldFrom", "?oldThrough", "?oldReview", "?oldReviewer"]
        - op: lte
          args: ["?observed", "?oldAt"]
    - id: REPLACEMENT.SAME.SCOPE
      head:
        relation: recordIssue
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body:
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
        - relation: scopeMismatch
          args: ["?old"]
    - id: RECORD.ELIGIBLE.BEFORE.REPLACEMENT
      head:
        relation: eligibleRecord
        args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
      body:
        - relation: record
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value", "?source", "?observed", "?from", "?through", "?review", "?reviewer"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: recordIssue
            args: ["?record", "?anyCode", "?anyReason"]
    - id: RECORD.EXPLICITLY.SUPERSEDED
      head:
        relation: supersededRecord
        args: ["?old"]
      body:
        - relation: eligibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
        - relation: replacement
          args: ["?record", "?old"]
    - id: RECORD.CURRENT.ADMISSIBLE
      head:
        relation: admissibleRecord
        args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
      body:
        - relation: eligibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: supersededRecord
            args: ["?record"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.wrong-scope
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", wrong-scope, 0]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", wrong-scope, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.unreviewed
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", unreviewed, 1]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", unreviewed, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.unqualified-source
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", unqualified-source, 2]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", unqualified-source, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.not-observed
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", not-observed, 3]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", not-observed, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.not-yet-valid
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, 4]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", not-yet-valid, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.expired
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", expired, 5]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", expired, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ISSUE.invalid-supersession
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, 6]
      body:
        - relation: recordIssue
          args: ["?record", invalid-supersession, "?reason"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.SUPERSEDED
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", superseded, 20]
      body:
        - relation: supersededRecord
          args: ["?record"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.ADMISSIBLE
      head:
        relation: dispositionOption
        args: ["?record", admissible, 30]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", "?value"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.PRIORITY
      head:
        relation: overriddenDisposition
        args: ["?record", "?code"]
      body:
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?code", "?rank"]
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?preferred", "?lower"]
        - op: lt
          args: ["?lower", "?rank"]
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.wrong-scope
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [wrong-scope, The record does not match the exact current shipment scope.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.unreviewed
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [unreviewed, An identified reviewer has not accepted this record.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.unqualified-source
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [unqualified-source, The supplied source kind does not establish this claim under this profile.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.not-observed
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [not-observed, The claimed observation is later than the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.not-yet-valid
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [not-yet-valid, The record is not valid at the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.expired
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [expired, The record has expired at the explicit assessment time.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.invalid-supersession
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [invalid-supersession, The declared replacement does not identify a strictly earlier record for the same scoped claim.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.superseded
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [superseded, A later current accepted record explicitly replaces this earlier same-claim record.]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.MEANING.admissible
      head:
        relation: dispositionMeaning
        args: [admissible, "The accepted, current, correctly scoped source qualifies under the authored evidence rule."]
      body: []
    - id: DISPOSITION.FINAL
      head:
        relation: recordDisposition
        args: ["?record", "?code", "?reason"]
      body:
        - relation: dispositionOption
          args: ["?record", "?code", "?rank"]
        - relation: dispositionMeaning
          args: ["?code", "?reason"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: overriddenDisposition
            args: ["?record", "?code"]
    - id: CLAIM.POSITIVE
      head:
        relation: positiveClaim
        args: ["?claim"]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", true]
    - id: CLAIM.NEGATIVE
      head:
        relation: negativeClaim
        args: ["?claim"]
      body:
        - relation: admissibleRecord
          args: ["?record", "?claim", false]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, established]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, contradicted]
      body:
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.UNRESOLVED.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, unresolved]
      body:
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [edi]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.edi
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [edi, conflicting]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [edi]
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [edi]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, established]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [item-order]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, contradicted]
      body:
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [item-order]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.UNRESOLVED.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, unresolved]
      body:
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [item-order]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.item-order
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [item-order, conflicting]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [item-order]
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [item-order]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.transport
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [transport, established]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [transport]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [transport]
    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.transport
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [transport, contradicted]
      body:
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [transport]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [transport]
    - id: FINDING.UNRESOLVED.transport
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [transport, unresolved]
      body:
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: positiveClaim
            args: [transport]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: negativeClaim
            args: [transport]
    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.transport
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [transport, conflicting]
      body:

        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [transport]
    - id: FINDING.ESTABLISHED.freight
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [freight, established]
      body:

    - id: FINDING.CONTRADICTED.freight
      head:

      body:

    - id: FINDING.CONFLICTING.freight
      head:
        relation: claimFinding
        args: [freight, conflicting]
      body:
        - relation: positiveClaim
          args: [freight]
        - relation: negativeClaim
          args: [freight]
  admission:
    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.0
      label: The current order declares retailer
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: expectedScope
          args: [retailer, "?value"]
    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.1
      label: The current order declares program
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: expectedScope
          args: [program, "?value"]
    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.2
      label: The current order declares supplierId
      when: []

        op: exists

          relation: expectedScope
          args: [supplierId, "?value"]
    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.3

      when: []

    - id: SCOPE.REQUIRED.4

What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?

Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.

    - id: COVERAGE

      meaning: "Check every admitted joint state and future outcome; zero probability never removes a state from feasibility coverage."

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

module.title: Current express carrier service from the same origin with pallet staging
module.description: A complete prospective route for one reviewed order revision. Current records, prospective recovery outcomes and actual completion remain distinct.
module.question: Can we complete this order using current express carrier service from the same origin with pallet staging?

claims.question: Do the recorded transaction tests establish EDI readiness for this order and supplier arrangement?
claims.meaning: The author-selected transaction set is shown successful for the exact order revision and supplier setup; a portal label alone is insufficient.

claims.question: Do the accepted order and item records agree with this shipment?
claims.meaning: Order revision, item identifiers, quantity, and destination agree under the authored reconciliation standard.

claims.question: Is this origin confirmed for the applicable transportation arrangement?
claims.meaning: A current accepted confirmation covers this supplier, origin, collect arrangement, and order revision under the authored profile.

claims.question: Do the recorded freight terms permit the proposed carrier services?
claims.meaning: The accepted collect terms and both authored carrier services agree for this order revision; no implied exception or waiver.

assumptions: The complete graph, fixed departure and mandatory requirements are authored. No repair graph is invented from case data.
All current joint states and both prospective recovery outcomes are checked. A native, exact-scope reviewed success-only premise may exclude the failed outcome; probabilities never exclude outcomes.
Records must cover their route-specific proof endpoint. A planned recovery effect is not evidence that work finished.

This bounded authoring profile holds at most 32 distinct incurred-payment records. Fixed native finance slots count each record once toward case expense and exclude paid costs from remaining cash demand; this capacity is not retailer policy.
The resource registry and permission registry are complete recorded judgments. Evaluating a route creates no real permission or booking.
Activity intervals are half-open; evidence and permission valid-through endpoints are inclusive.

requirements.label: SUFFICIENCY
requirements.meaning: Each timed mandatory readiness condition is established by admissible current evidence or explicitly supplied as a prospective postcondition under a reviewed outcome premise where the recovery route requires it. Planned postconditions never establish current facts.

requirements.label: COVERAGE
requirements.meaning: Check every admitted joint state and future outcome; zero probability never removes a state from feasibility coverage.

requirements.label: ACCESS
requirements.meaning: Required resource access and scoped, current permissions cover the corresponding work.

requirements.label: TIME
requirements.meaning: Bookings, all preparation, fixed carrier departures, receiving, and validity intervals fit the commitment.

requirements.label: COST
requirements.meaning: Total case expense includes incurred and remaining expense once; remaining cash pays only future spend.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.description: Determine whether one complete static plan can satisfy every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted scenario. Compare feasible plans only after whole-plan execution feasibility is established.

authoring.guidance:
What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?
Which factual records and admitted states are we relying on?
Which complete choices may the planner make?
Which activities, dependencies, calendars and capacities must the same plan respect?
Which scoped permissions must cover each required operation?
Which joint operating scenarios must this commitment withstand?
Which obligations are mandatory, and how will passing complete plans be compared?
Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

structuralSlots.description: Declare one time origin, common time and money units, and additional numeric units.
Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.
Bind the input relation containing explicit joint scenarios.
Bind typed acyclic consequences using the installed expression language.
Declare static activity actors, timing and renewable resource demands.
Map resource capacities and existing bookings.
Name and explain every mandatory commitment obligation.
Bind predicates and shared resource-capacity checks to obligations.
Declare nonrefundable charges and optional timed refundable holds.
Declare feasible-only lexicographic comparison.
Optionally require complete finite lookup coverage.
Supply domain vocabulary without changing calculations.
State accepted premises and the applicability boundary.

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.

authoring.guidance:
What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?
Which factual records and admitted states are we relying on?
Which complete choices may the planner make?
Which activities, dependencies, calendars and capacities must the same plan respect?
Which scoped permissions must cover each required operation?
Which joint operating scenarios must this commitment withstand?
Which obligations are mandatory, and how will passing complete plans be compared?
Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

      waivable: false
    - id: COVERAGE

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid
