      meaning: Each timed mandatory readiness condition is established by admissible current evidence or explicitly supplied as a prospective postcondition under a reviewed outcome premise where the recovery route requires it. Planned postconditions never establish current facts.
      waivable: false
    - id: COVERAGE
      label: COVERAGE
      meaning: "Check every admitted joint state and future outcome; zero probability never removes a state from feasibility coverage."
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: ACCESS
      meaning: "Required resource access and scoped, current permissions cover the corresponding work."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

module.title: Complete the EDI recovery package, then use express freight with pallet staging after a readiness review
module.description: A complete prospective route for one reviewed order revision. Current records, prospective recovery outcomes and actual completion remain distinct. This response context includes one optional readiness review and response delay before reserving the complete route.
module.question: Can we complete this order using complete the edi recovery package, then use express freight with pallet staging?

claims.question: Do the recorded transaction tests establish EDI readiness for this order and supplier arrangement?
claims.meaning: The author-selected transaction set is shown successful for the exact order revision and supplier setup; a portal label alone is insufficient.

claims.question: Do the accepted order and item records agree with this shipment?
claims.meaning: Order revision, item identifiers, quantity, and destination agree under the authored reconciliation standard.

claims.question: Is this origin confirmed for the applicable transportation arrangement?
claims.meaning: A current accepted confirmation covers this supplier, origin, collect arrangement, and order revision under the authored profile.

claims.question: Do the recorded freight terms permit the proposed carrier services?
claims.meaning: The accepted collect terms and both authored carrier services agree for this order revision; no implied exception or waiver.

learningContext.responseMeaning: Reserve only after investigation completion plus the separately supplied response time. The investigation changes knowledge, never the modeled current readiness state.

assumptions: The complete graph, fixed departure and mandatory requirements are authored. No repair graph is invented from case data.
All current joint states and both prospective recovery outcomes are checked. A native, exact-scope reviewed success-only premise may exclude the failed outcome; probabilities never exclude outcomes.
Records must cover their route-specific proof endpoint. A planned recovery effect is not evidence that work finished.

This bounded authoring profile holds at most 32 distinct incurred-payment records. Fixed native finance slots count each record once toward case expense and exclude paid costs from remaining cash demand; this capacity is not retailer policy.
The resource registry and permission registry are complete recorded judgments. Evaluating a route creates no real permission or booking.
Activity intervals are half-open; evidence and permission valid-through endpoints are inclusive.

requirements.label: SUFFICIENCY
requirements.meaning: Each timed mandatory readiness condition is established by admissible current evidence or explicitly supplied as a prospective postcondition under a reviewed outcome premise where the recovery route requires it. Planned postconditions never establish current facts.

requirements.label: COVERAGE
requirements.meaning: Check every admitted joint state and future outcome; zero probability never removes a state from feasibility coverage.

requirements.label: ACCESS
requirements.meaning: Required resource access and scoped, current permissions cover the corresponding work.

requirements.label: TIME
requirements.meaning: Bookings, all preparation, fixed carrier departures, receiving, and validity intervals fit the commitment.

requirements.label: COST
requirements.meaning: Total case expense includes incurred and remaining expense once; remaining cash pays only future spend.

authoring.guidance: Populate the installed pattern contract. Supply business meanings as module data and reviewed observations as case data.

definition.title: Assess the value of learning
definition.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.

caseDerivation: Priors cover every frozen module.state and payoffs cover every declared action/state cell.
Study inputs cover every declared study and every state/report likelihood cell, including explicit zeros.
Accepted facts use frozen typed attributes; optional reference records follow frozen module.recordTypes without becoming accepted facts.
Case inputs may vary cash, deadlines, durations, fees, distributions and declared sensitivity scenarios, not objective semantics or identities.

app.name: Decide whether to buy a readiness review
app.description: Compare an available complete route now with one readiness review followed by a complete route. Reviewed business consequences are combined with native route expense, the review fee, and each response’s complete operating checks.

# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: assess-value-of-learning/1
module:
  id: walmart-first-order-staged-learning
  version: "1.2.0"
  title: Decide whether to buy a readiness review
  description: "Compare an available complete route now with one readiness review followed by a complete route. Reviewed business consequences are combined with native route expense, the review fee, and each response’s complete operating checks."
  question: "Would a timely readiness review improve our shipment choice while preserving a complete feasible response?"
  boundary: "One fictional order revision, one optional readiness investigation, then one complete current or EDI-recovery route. It neither performs recovery nor supplies actual readiness evidence."
  executionFeasibility:
    version: 1
  objective:
    criterion: risk-neutral-expected-money
    unit: USD cent
    timeUnit: minute
    beneficiary: Supplier responsible for the scoped order
    horizon: This accepted order revision through its receipt commitment
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: walmart-supplier-operations
        label: Walmart Supplier Operations
      useCase:
        id: walmart-first-order
        label: Review a Walmart first order
    requiredCapabilities:
      - id: learning-execution-feasibility
        version: 1
    learning:
      profileId: walmart-first-order-readiness-recovery
      profileVersion: "0.1.0-draft.1"
      studyId: readiness-review
      consequenceMeaning: "Reviewed gross monetary consequences exclude route expense and the study fee. The native learning payoff subtracts complete no-study route expense once; the study fee is charged separately once."
  assumptions: ["Probabilities, gross consequences, logical report support, and report likelihoods are supplied and separately reviewed; they are never inferred from evidence interpretation counts.", A route supported by reviewed prospective recovery can be an action available now even when current EDI readiness is false. It remains prospective and must satisfy every mandatory operating check., "Every logically possible report needs a complete response that passes native planning across all current states and admitted recovery outcomes the report leaves possible, including zero-probability states and reports.", "The delayed planning assessment includes the investigation activity, resource use, fee, purchase authority, response time and complete subsequent route. A late result cannot inform an earlier reservation.", "The fee is included once in the native delayed branch expense and cash checks, and once in the learning comparison. It is excluded from the supplied gross consequences and base route expense.", Unknown probabilities and declined learning do not prevent evidence or commitment planning. Without a currently supported complete action this profile does not manufacture an acting-now benchmark., "Hypothetical reports do not become actual observations, release permission, purchase authorization or completed work."]

definitionContract.title: Assess the value of learning
definitionContract.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.

module.title: Decide whether to buy a readiness review
module.description: Compare an available complete route now with one readiness review followed by a complete route. Reviewed business consequences are combined with native route expense, the review fee, and each response’s complete operating checks.
module.question: Would a timely readiness review improve our shipment choice while preserving a complete feasible response?
module.boundary: One fictional order revision, one optional readiness investigation, then one complete current or EDI-recovery route. It neither performs recovery nor supplies actual readiness evidence.

objective.beneficiary: Supplier responsible for the scoped order
objective.horizon: This accepted order revision through its receipt commitment

learning.consequenceMeaning: Reviewed gross monetary consequences exclude route expense and the study fee. The native learning payoff subtracts complete no-study route expense once; the study fee is charged separately once.

assumptions: Probabilities, gross consequences, logical report support, and report likelihoods are supplied and separately reviewed; they are never inferred from evidence interpretation counts.
A route supported by reviewed prospective recovery can be an action available now even when current EDI readiness is false. It remains prospective and must satisfy every mandatory operating check.

Every logically possible report needs a complete response that passes native planning across all current states and admitted recovery outcomes the report leaves possible, including zero-probability states and reports.

The delayed planning assessment includes the investigation activity, resource use, fee, purchase authority, response time and complete subsequent route. A late result cannot inform an earlier reservation.
The fee is included once in the native delayed branch expense and cash checks, and once in the learning comparison. It is excluded from the supplied gross consequences and base route expense.
Unknown probabilities and declined learning do not prevent evidence or commitment planning. Without a currently supported complete action this profile does not manufacture an acting-now benchmark.
Hypothetical reports do not become actual observations, release permission, purchase authorization or completed work.

actions.label: Obtain EDI evidence valid for the route

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed successful records for the author-selected EDI transaction set, linked to the exact supplier arrangement and order revision.

actions.label: Reconcile the order and evidence interval

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed accepted order revision and item/quantity/destination reconciliation.
args.nextAction: Reconcile the accepted order and required shipment quantity, with evidence valid through receipt.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

actions.label: Obtain transportation evidence valid through departure

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed transportation confirmation for the exact origin, collect arrangement, and current order revision.
args.nextAction: Obtain a scoped transportation confirmation valid through the selected departure.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

actions.label: Obtain freight-term evidence valid through departure

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed accepted freight terms and carrier-service compatibility for the current order revision.
args.nextAction: Obtain accepted freight-term evidence valid through the proposed departure.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: A reviewed complete issued-permission registry for the relevant actors, activities, order scope and intervals.
args.nextAction: Review the grant registry and obtain the relevant issued records; absence from an incomplete register does not establish denial or authority.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: Issued permission covering the exact EDI repair activity, case scope, time interval, and amount.
args.nextAction: Issue or decline an actual scoped EDI-repair permission; a request is not permission.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: Issued freight-booking authority for the exact actor, route, order revision, activity interval and amount.
args.nextAction: Obtain a matching issued freight-booking grant before committing money.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: Issued shipment-release authority covering the named actor, exact scope and release interval.
args.nextAction: Obtain a matching issued release grant; an accepted calculation does not issue permission.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed accepted freight terms and carrier-service compatibility for the current order revision.
args.nextAction: Seek a revised feasible service and any required accepted order changes; review the complete preparation, departure and receiving schedule.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: A reviewed resource assignment, capacity and calendar covering every required activity.
args.nextAction: Confirm the required resource assignment and capacity, or propose a complete alternative with a workable calendar.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.

args.requiredEvidence: Reviewed quotes, incurred-payment records, an expense ceiling and remaining cash after the recorded payments.
args.nextAction: Review the expense or remaining-cash blocker and obtain a funded complete alternative or a revised approved limit.
args.deadlineMeaning: Assign the next action before the earlier case/carrier cutoff; actual proof must cover the required operating interval.
